transcript.text: Thank you, Dr. Lee. My concern is about the file storage provisions in the implementation draft. The draft currently specifies that student files will be stored using the vendor's online workspace. However, I reviewed the executed vendor license in the procurement file, and it clearly states that student files may be stored only in the district LMS — with no uploads to the vendor workspace permitted. This signed license has not been attached to the curriculum plan, so this critical restriction was not reflected in the draft. The implementation draft as written would put us in violation of our executed vendor license agreement. We need to revise the file storage provisions to specify the district LMS as the sole storage location for student files before this plan can be approved.

Second, every lesson must include teacher-provided oral directions for multilingual learners, which is not specified anywhere in the current draft.
